theme_strategy: Minimalist Mono + Subtle Accent (Linear-inspired). Must support seamless Light and Dark modes. Dark mode should feel like a premium command center (almost black, stark white text, 1px strokes). Light mode should be clinical, precise, and crisp (off-white, 1px grey strokes).

typography.strategy: Swiss Brutalist meets Old Money Tech. Reject default generic sans-serifs.
typography.heading_font: Cabinet Grotesk (Fallback: Outfit or Space Grotesk is forbidden, so use Clash Display or Outfit)
typography.body_font: IBM Plex Sans (Fallback: JetBrains Mono for data/stats)

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-medium

rules: Never use pure black (#000000) or pure white (#FFFFFF) for broad backgrounds. Always tint slightly.
Use Accent sparingly. Mostly monochrome UI. Accent is reserved for the primary CTA, active states, and subtle glows.
Avoid large blocks of filled color. Use 1px borders and empty space to define boundaries.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: The 'Tracing Beam' / Grid Borders look. Cards should have no box-shadow in dark mode, only a crisp 1px border. In light mode, a very diffuse, soft shadow is acceptable.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use only for the sticky navigation header. Dark: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10. Light: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-black/10.
visual_enhancers.gradients: No heavy full-screen gradients. Use a subtle CSS radial-gradient mesh at the very top of the hero section (e.g., a faint blue/white glow fading into the background).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp borders on everything. Buttons should have an inner border to mimic a physical 'tactile' edge.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_system: Generous spacing. Use p-8 or p-12 for main sections. p-6 for cards. gap-6 or gap-8 for grids.
grids_and_layouts.about_section: MODE A: The 'Tetris' Grid (Bento Box). Asymmetrical layout of feature cards. Mix square (col-span-4), tall (col-span-4 row-span-2), and wide (col-span-8) blocks.
grids_and_layouts.result_card: MODE B: High Density Grid. Data-heavy layout. Executive Summary spans full width. 5W1H and Key Points in a strict 2-column or 3-column grid. Tight gap-4. Every piece of data is enclosed in a subtle bordered cell.

component_specifics.hero_url_input: Massive, center-aligned or optical left-aligned input field. text-xl or text-2xl. Minimal background. 1px border that lights up with the accent color and a soft glow on focus. Contains the 'Summarize' primary button inside or right next to it.
component_specifics.primary_button: Sleek, not pill-shaped. max 6px border-radius. In dark mode, solid white text on a very dark grey background with a white/20 border, transitioning to a subtle accent glow on hover.
component_specifics.secondary_button: Transparent background, 1px border, text color dims. Hover: text color brightens, border color brightens.
result_card_sections: 1. Article Info: Small, monospace-like meta row.
2. Executive Summary: Large text, h3 size, taking prominence.
3. Grid: Key Points (list), Main Issue (highlighted box), Root Cause (box), Actions (ordered list), 5W1H (table or grid of mini-cards).
4. Confidence Level: A tiny pill badge (Green/Yellow/Red dot + text) positioned at the top right of the card.
5. Latest Updates: Hidden by default, toggled via a 'Show Latest Updates' secondary button that expands smoothly.
component_specifics.export_share_group: A tight flex row of small icon-only or icon+text buttons (Copy, PDF, DOCX, Share) situated at the bottom or top right of the result card.
component_specifics.loading_state: Avoid generic spinners. Use a staggered opacity animation on a skeleton or a sleek progress bar that moves left to right with friendly text ('Analyzing root cause...', 'Extracting insights...').

motion.transitions: Use specific transitions. E.g., transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform duration-300.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for Bento grid cards and Result Card sections. Use framer-motion.
motion.hover: Subtle -translate-y-[2px] on interactive cards. No heavy scaling.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG standards. Do not use grey text on grey backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: All buttons and inputs MUST have a clear focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent focus:outline-none).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='summarize-button', data-testid='url-input').
accessibility.theme_toggle: Must be accessible by keyboard, with clear aria-labels.

media_and_icons.icons: lucide-react. Keep stroke width to 1.5 or 2 for a crisp, engineered look.
media_and_icons.images: No heavy photography required. The UI is the art. Use pure CSS patterns (dots, grids) for empty states or backgrounds if needed.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build this as a single-page React app (e.g., using standard React + Vite + Tailwind, or Next.js if configured, but stick to standard React conventions for the given environment).
Implement light and dark mode using Tailwind's 'dark' class strategy. Include a toggle in the header.
Use Shadcn UI components for complex interactions (Dropdowns, Tabs if needed), but heavily strip their default Vercel-look borders and customize them to fit this stark, Linear-style aesthetic.
Do NOT use HTML <input type='date'> or <select>. Use Shadcn.
Use Framer Motion for the loading state and the expansion of the 'Latest Updates' section.
Ensure the hero section is visually striking yet purely functional. The URL input is the star.
Make sure to mock the AI summarization process. Add a setTimeout or similar to simulate the 5-10 second loading phase so the user can see the elegant loading animations.
When formatting the 'Recommended Actions', clearly label them as 'AI-generated' per the prompt.
Do not use generic font families like Inter. Apply Cabinet Grotesk (or similar) for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body in the CSS.
Ensure responsive design. The BENTO grid on mobile must stack to 1 column.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
